[BSP reconstruction 00bd12a0] update
Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet app_init_alloc_string_helpers, assembly-verified; drops the _Provisional suffix. __thiscall, ECX the free-ring subobject (pool+0x6acfcc for the string pool, pool+4 for the game pool), stack (void** block, uint size_class), RET 8; the block is read through the pointer and never written back. Ring layout: 0x80000 pointer slots at +0, head[] at +0x200000, tail[] one class array later (+0x200258 for 150 classes, +0x200204 for 129), then the live count and the high-water mark. Each size class owns a contiguous circular slice laid down by the constructor as head[i] = i*stride (0xda7 string pool, 0xfe0 game pool), tail[i] = head[i]-1. Push advances the class's own tail; if that collides with the head of the next class, that class's whole region rotates forward one slot and its first element is displaced into the vacated slot, becoming the block that still needs a home, cascading until a class with slack is found or the walk wraps back to the starting class. Finally ring[tail[last]] takes the carried block, the live count rises and the high-water mark follows it. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_ALLOC_STRINGS.md.
